positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wiith – Collaborated on an iOS app featuring a shared interactive canvas where multiple users could place, move, rotate, and scale photos, GIFs, videos, drawings, and text in real time using WebRTC for live updates across iOS and Android clients. Included playback of past interactions, live video chat, and text chat. Integrated data syncing through an AWS Amplify backend using GraphQL. Served as the primary developer for the playback system.

Fide – Developing an iOS app with chat channels, group chats, DMs, and multi-person live video chat. Led development of the Moments feature (similar to Instagram Stories), enabling users to post moments and receive responses either as text comments or visual overlay comments (photos, GIFs, videos, drawings) that animate when viewed. Also led development of the profile collage pages, allowing users to assemble visual profiles that others can browse. Reused and extended core systems from Wiith to accelerate development on Fide’s similar backend.

positions.title: Staff iOS Engineer
positions.description: Worked on upsell placements and modals to allow users to subscribe to Instacart’s subscription service, Express.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the Search & Discover and Identity & Commerce sections of the Quibi iOS app covering everything from sign up, subscription, browsing & previewing content, and user settings.  Quibi was a premium content video streaming service founded by Jeffery Katzenberg and Meg Whitman.  Built the application from the ground up in Swift, as the company’s first iOS developer and was involved in early prototyping of the apps ability to switch between landscape and portrait video.

positions.title: Lead Mobile Architect
positions.description: Led development of a new mobile apps to connect Loot Crate's subscribers ("Looters") more closely to their areas of fandom.  We started from scratch building a completely new iOS app in Swift and were able to deliver our first MVP version in 5 months to the App Store that included a full purchase flow and account management.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Engineer at Ticketmaster working on the Purchase Team for the Ticketmaster mobile apps to enhance the overall purchase experience of fans on iOS (Swift/Objective-C) and as primary developer of the cross-platform Interactive Seat Map (ISM) library (OpenGL ES/C).  The ISM quickly renders venues with over a hundred thousand seats and allows fans and sellers to select the exact seats that they want.  The rendering core runs natively on iOS, Android, and tvOS platforms and is being leveraged a part of 4 different Ticketmaster apps for both B2C and B2B applications on iPhone, iPad, and Android.

Also was the Technical Lead over the development for two B2B applications for iPad starting from inception to delivery, over several years.  The apps allow Ticketmaster clients to sell tickets, perform customer relationship management (CRM), view reports on attendance and revenue, and assist with entry to the venue.  External interfaces include printing tickets to a BLE printer, using the camera to scan ticket barcodes, and using the external accessory framework to interface with a credit card scanner.  Personal contribution was technical leadership in a Scrum/Agile process, working with product and project management, defining tasks in JIRA, architecting design solutions for the client software and the interaction with the server, coding in Swift and Objective-C, UI design and development, and working with the security and PCI auditing teams.  The software has passed PCI compliance and has a strong reputation for being delivered on-time with high quality.

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead and sometimes interim Product Manager of a commercial 3D geospatial mapping & visualization product (similar to Google Earth in capability) which has served various defense and security programs in the US and Australia including in the White House Situation Room.  The software was written in C++ and OpenGL on Windows personal computers.   Lead the team using Scrum/Agile software practices.  

Also lead the development of various mobile products including an in-house encrypted S/MIME-based email and calendar client on iPad that accessed data from an Microsoft Exchange backend via SOAP, and an Android app that included support for facial recognition.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented 3D geospatial mapping & visualization software.  Lead architect and designer of the Application Programmer's Interface (API), that allowed the software to be easily embedded and extended, even allowing custom rendering by client applications.

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description: Designed and developed a new Computer Science course offering at UCLA Extension on Object-Oriented Design using Design Patterns.   The course taught principles of object-oriented software design (the SOLID principles described by Robert Martin) and discussed benefits and drawbacks of the patterns presented in the book "Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software".    The class focused solely on software design independent of language.   Taught the class for 3 quarters  while working at Aerojet and before leaving to work at Autometric.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a variety of satellite ground station analysis and visualization tools on Silicon Graphics and other workstations in C++ and other languages, specializing in 3D graphics and user interface development.
